description:
## Goal

Make approving prompt-manager decisions as fast as possible. Support batch operations, keyboard navigation, focused pending-only views, and real-time updates.

## Implementation

### Batch Approval
- "Approve All Recommended" button that accepts the agent-recommended option for all pending decisions in one action
- Selective batch: checkbox per decision → "Approve Selected" button
- Batch API endpoint: `POST /api/v1/decisions/batch-update` accepting an array of decision updates
- Confirmation dialog showing what will be approved before executing

### Keyboard Navigation
- `j` / `k` — navigate between pending decisions
- `Enter` — accept the recommended option (or first option if no recommendation)
- `1-9` — select option by number
- `r` — reject current decision
- `n` — add notes to current decision
- `a` — approve all recommended (with confirmation)
- Visual focus indicator showing which decision is currently selected

### Focused Pending View
- Default filter to show only `pending` decisions (hide accepted/rejected)
- Toggle to show all statuses
- Counter badge: "12 pending decisions" with urgency indicator
- Sort pending decisions by: age (oldest first), team, context tag

### Real-Time Updates
- Replace 10-second polling with WebSocket notifications for decision state changes
- Instant UI update when agents submit new decisions
- Toast notification for new pending decisions

### Option Rationale Visibility
- Show all option rationales inline by default (not hidden behind hover)
- Collapsible if there are many options (>4)
- Highlight recommended option with visual distinction

## Key Files

- Decision handlers: `scenarios/prompt-manager/api/heartbeat/handlers.go` — add batch endpoint
- Pending decisions: `scenarios/prompt-manager/api/heartbeat/handlers_pending.go` — WebSocket support
- Decision log UI: `scenarios/prompt-manager/ui/src/components/editor/teamTabs/DecisionLogView.tsx` — keyboard nav + batch UX
- Pending store: `scenarios/prompt-manager/ui/src/stores/pendingDecisionsStore.ts` — WebSocket sync
- Polling hook: `scenarios/prompt-manager/ui/src/hooks/usePendingDecisions.ts` — replace with WebSocket
